titles.title: No. 36 – Special

description: Reddish black leaves with dark veins erupt from the center of the canvas. The leaves have jagged edges, and several fade into the plain white paper surrounding them. To the left of the leaves, three small white flowers with yellow centers also appear to dissolve into the paper.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
